capabilities: Embed interactive 3D model viewers in notes
Browse a folder's models in a gallery
Capture screenshots and copy to clipboard
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); no mobile support. Importing from the file manager and galleries of folders outside the vault are desktop-only. Hardware acceleration (Settings → Appearance) improves performance but is optional; models still show without it. Rendering powered by three.js (MIT).
problem: Obsidian has no native way to view or interact with 3D model files inside notes.

relations.evidence: Editor Enhancer: drag the whole viewer like any other block, and fold viewers into toggle lists
Section Blocks: dropped models go to a <note name> media folder next to the note.

summary: 3D model viewer that embeds interactive models in notes, with folder galleries, animation playback, skeleton view, and screenshots.
